description: Expected-evidence absence is a first-class residual at the control grain, and it opens a deliberation over a Pareto frontier of consumer-declared, Pareto-INCOMPARABLE regimes (docs/regime_pareto_frontier_prereg.md) rather than climbing a total-order ladder.  The general half of the metastability fix (docs/metastable_regime_escalation.md): a regime that promises evidence and delivers none inside its horizon is escalated instead of replayed forever; WHICH regime it escalates to is the shared embodied_pareto_profile primitive's relational dominance plus one explicit, declared selection policy -- never a smuggled scalar.

microtheory.name: control_regime_escalation
microtheory.description: no expected evidence inside the horizon -> mint a ControlRegimeImpasse -> open a deliberation over a fresh Pareto frontier of the consumer's declared regimes -> publish the frontier member the declared situational policy prefers.  The domain defines evidence, regime semantics, and the per-axis achievable-margin formulas.
